title: add-jsonschema-strict-mode-openai-compat-improved-errors
author: Priya Rao
description: Implements server-side JSON Schema structured output support and an OpenAI-compatible response_format/strict parameter mapping. Adds a new validation pass for response_format="json_schema" with an optional strict mode that returns machine-readable validation errors. Includes improved error fields (error_type, error_path, message) to help client-side handling and automated rollbacks. Streaming stability changes: when structured output is requested we buffer until final candidate is available for validation while preserving streaming for freeform responses; added safeguards for partial KV cache in streaming. Also updates the OpenAI compatibility layer so response_format and strict query/body params map to the new behavior. Tests, docs, and SDK compatibility layers updated. This PR aims to be backward compatible for clients not opting into response_format and includes detailed release notes and examples.
commits: Initial implementation: add response_format=json_schema handling in API surface and validation layer
Add strict mode toggle and improved validation error types exposed to clients
OpenAI compatibility mapping: support response_format=json_schema and strict=true parameters
Add unit and integration tests, update docs and SDK compat layers
Fix: streaming stability with structured output streams and incremental validation
review_comments: Ethan Kim: Please confirm backward compatibility when response_format is omitted. Author: We fall back to existing freeform text behavior; added explicit tests.

Marco Sanchez: Streaming behavior with structured output needs a guard for partial KV cache; added a chunking sanity check and unit tests.
release_notes: Added API support for response_format=json_schema with an optional strict mode that validates model output against provided JSON Schema. Improved validation error messages and added OpenAI-compat mapping for response_format and strict parameters. SDK updates and docs included. No breaking changes for clients not using response_format.
notes: Motivation: customers want structured output guarantees for downstream parsing. This PR implements server-side JSON Schema validation, exposes structured validation errors, and wires OpenAI-compatible request params to the new behavior. Implementation notes: validation runs as a post-processing step before streaming finalization; strict=true will return a 400 with a structured error object on validation failure; strict=false will attach best-effort validation hints in metadata and fall back to original output. Streaming compatibility: we buffer final object validation where streaming is enabled for structured outputs, and emit partial tokens as before for freeform output. Testing: added unit tests and integration tests that run against a lightweight model stub to validate both pass and fail cases.
